name: Fukayama Botan
source:
She is a third-year student who is the chairperson of the committee and a kind-hearted mother figure. 

She is a natural type who accepts everything with an open heart and a spirit of compassion, but at the same time, she sometimes brings troublesome things to the school with her own good intentions. 

This is the second time she has been pregnant while in school.

[From [url=http://pacopacosoft.jp/dl/pk004/]official site[/url]]
